figurative_meaning_bn: অনিচ্ছায় একান্ত বাধ্য হয়ে কিছু করা
figurative_meaning_en: To do something unwillingly due to extreme compulsion
similar_in_english: Between a rock and a hard place
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরিস্থিতির চাপে দায়ঠেলা হয়ে সে সম্মতি দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He did the work grudgingly out of necessity.
Under pressure, he unwillingly agreed to it.
note: The idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of reluctance in fulfilling duties.
